name: Small group study
summary: Lead a small group study with a session plan, leader prompts and reminders for each meeting.
duration: Set by your number of weeks

plan_blueprint.calendar: Weekly meetings with prompts attached and a reminder to members the day before. Week counts follow your chosen length.

approach_variants.habit: Same day and time every week, with a reading reminder the day before.
approach_variants.willpower: Read-ahead challenge and a countdown to the final session.
approach_variants.time: Meeting and leader-prep blocks on the calendar; weekly time review.
approach_variants.reward: A group celebration at the end that members choose together.
approach_variants.resource: First week gathers books or guides, a venue, childcare and a co-leader.

guardrails: Members choose their own visibility; the leader sees only what each member shares.
Prayer requests and personal shares in the group stay private unless the person chooses to share.
Every plan item can be edited, moved or removed, and you can add your own steps.
restart_rules: A cancelled session moves the plan back one week.

creator.license: GoalKin launch template; replaced when a creator version is approved

price_log.basis: Launch proposal per docs/MARKETPLACE.md; pending owner approval
